name: Tuscan Roast Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 pound (450 g) each Russet potatoes and redskin potatoes, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) cubes
1 ½ tsp each dried parsley, rosemary, thyme, basil and oregano

steps: Heat a large pot of water to a boil. Add potatoes and cook for 10 minutes. Shock in a bowl of ice water.
Combine remaining ingredients. Add potatoes and toss to coat.
Spread out in one even layer on your largest baking pan. Roast at 450°F (230°C) for 20 minutes, stirring halfway.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
